body:
The earlier affinity fit produced nearly constant outputs, and mixed supervision obscured which parameters trained. This PR adds a modular model with direct assay supervision, explicit measurement/context contracts, training-support checks, and reproducible exact-versus-sampled peptide-availability experiments. It remains **draft**: the qualified biological system in #130 and #132 is incomplete.

The latest [frozen organ-transfer comparison](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/a9ae724b026ae3f278ef11e11b31e3f26ef9e11d/experiments/2026-10-25_1747_codex_intact-method-transfer/README.md) evaluates 21 existing predictors on 425 admitted measurements without fitting or adapting them. On the 236 primary measurements, sequence RMSE is **0.288802**, versus **0.216691 for no change** and **0.348240 for length**. Prediction variation survives, but transfer accuracy fails the preset screen. Exact-gradient and conditional-score models also lose to no change. All 8,925 predictions, source admission, metrics and bootstrap draws independently verify. This does not establish APC concentrations or an RL advantage.

## Model and data flow

- Shared sequence representations feed direct affinity/stability heads. Class II evaluates sliding registers and flanks; class I retains whole-peptide context.
- Optional annotation heads predict molecular species/context with explicit supplied values and overrides. Paired-TCR scoring conditions on the receptor before pMHC-register pooling; qualified TCR cohorts and TCRvdb access remain pending.
- APC inputs distinguish species, cell type, concurrent machinery states and cytokine exposure. Defaults carry provenance; supplied states override assumptions. Purified binding has its own context contract.
- Processing and MS response have separate features/readouts. Raw targets, training-only scaling, subset-specific allocation, parameter/feature support and compatible checkpoint transfer make trained scope explicit. Exact resume retains optimizer/sampler/RNG state; GPU bitwise equivalence is unproven.
- Shared Hitlist materialization preserves quantities, missingness, inequalities, reused contributors, conflicting copies, parent alternatives and material uncertainty.
- Experimental exact and sampled processing models cover short fragments/nonbinders. Full mixed-assay integration and validated precursor-relative APC amounts remain outstanding.

## Biological evidence

| Task | Result | Scope and limitation |
|---|---|---|
| Local IC50, one epoch | Test RMSE 1.1613 vs ridge 1.2291 log10(nM); Spearman 0.5117 | Inspected peptide-disjoint splits/shared studies; class-II recall 0.0882 and 0/203 bounds satisfied. Convergence and qualification unresolved. |
| HAP1 knockout response | Test RMSE 0.573380 vs calibrated precursor 0.631249 | Same-study molecular-component holdout; mechanistic ERAP augmentation adds no gain. |
| Non-MHC measured MS1 | Test RMSE 0.449828 vs length 0.520456 | Four held-out synthesized pools; purity/load/response confounded. |
| Nominal standard-dose response | Development macro RMSE 0.334620 vs constant 0.665914 | Nine selected standards, two DIA methods; known-standard offsets, no unseen-peptide or APC transfer. |
| MAPP baseline composition | Exact test RMSE 0.415095 vs uniform 0.439892 | Observed candidates; sequence-versus-length misses the 5% criterion. REINFORCE has no advantage. |
| Native-cell chemical response | Exact test RMSE 0.243207 vs condition 0.250953 | Combined exact/bounded loss improves only 0.59%; not concentration. |
| Macrophage MHC-I response | Test RMSE 0.139278 vs condition 0.120011 | Failed; almost constant without precursor. |
| Intact product/substrate kinetics | Fragmentation test RMSE 0.359038 vs direct 0.228184 | Failed same-peptide future-time forecast on one substrate/preparation. |
| Native HEK293T PSMD2 response | Sequence test RMSE 0.423308 vs zero 0.424407 | Failed fixed gate; prediction SD below 1% of target SD. |
| Frozen intact organ transfer | Sequence primary RMSE 0.288802 vs zero 0.216691 | Failed; prediction SD 0.208033 vs target SD 0.208481. Supplied baselines, one substrate/source animal; no APC calibration. |

These are different contracts, not one common benchmark. [Canonical registry and full reports](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/155f719b85130367bff37f7d514c60dcb3a66502/experiments/experiment_log.md) preserve splits, source scope, prior outcome exposure, predictions, failed hypotheses and runtime.

## What the recent experiments establish

The native PSMD2 acquisition diagnostic found strong training-only replicate consistency (median Pearson 0.8382), while boundary features and reference-invariant objectives failed their preset materiality gates. Further feature/optimizer expansion on that response-only cohort has stopped. Its original outer groups remain closed.

The temporal sequence model improved same-parent development RMSE by 8.772% over length, with an interval including zero. The frozen F3 test now shows that improvement does not establish transfer: it is 33.28% worse than no change. The paired peptide-bootstrap 95% gain interval is [-70.50%, -5.62%]. No learned arm beats zero; later-time results cannot rescue failure. This result concerns the simple temporal comparators, and does not diagnose the older full-model IC50 underfit.

The synthetic archive includes exact enumeration, REINFORCE, clipping × group-standardization factorials, reuse, reference KL, partial observation, multiset objectives and hybrids. In real kinetics, conditional-score hybrids retain exact forward values and sample gradients; they are not simulator-only RL or GRPO. They matched failed exact predictors at 1.8–2.5× prior core training cost. New frozen inference finds no material exact/score advantage.

## Shared data and validation

[Hitlist PR848](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/pull/848) adds strict and method-supported F3 recipes. [Original Methods qualification](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/a9ae724b026ae3f278ef11e11b31e3f26ef9e11d/experiments/2026-10-25_1735_codex_intact-search-contract/README.md) supplies a typed no-additional-modification search assertion with article/paragraph hashes and scope; raw nulls, original source generation and strict recipes remain unchanged. Exact study software/export conversion and biochemical purity are unproven. The original strict cohort remains closed at zero support; a new, preregistered method-supported comparison admitted 236 primary and 189 later cells. All 8,138 source decisions and 155 baseline measurements independently replay. [Source clarification](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/issues/831#issuecomment-6401211175) leaves scan normalization, calibration and preparation/machinery metadata open.

The Hitlist extension passes format/lint, 30 focused tests including both strict recipe parity checks, and 3,594 default tests. All hosted CI, including integration, passed and PR848 merged as 85ff2c81. The exact 2.0.41 release build also passed; both distributions independently match clean main and the successful Actions artifact. Public PyPI publication awaits explicit user approval; no upload has executed. Earlier native-source/contrast and dilution-source releases are published and independently byte-verified in their experiment records.

Presto's latest seven guarded scientific stages pass: 17.844s total, 738.36MiB maximum RSS, local CPU/float64/one numerical thread, no Modal or shared-environment changes. Independent checks cover 44 predictor reconstructions, 252 metric records, 1,000 bootstrap draws and 12 exact/score pairs. All 110 new required artifacts were verified against staged and committed Git bytes; all 31 frozen model inputs were already committed. Tracked Python lint/format passes. Whole-directory lint also encounters untracked archived/external source under data; original bytes and the diagnostic are preserved. Both a9ae724 hosted PR/push runs passed before this report commit; current-head CI is pending.

The new [nontryptic calibration source screen](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/717ed59e0938b10f3bedc2c5fad760ce65d65613/experiments/2026-10-25_1816_codex_nontryptic-calibration-screen/README.md) finds separate nominal-dose and summed fragment-ion signals for 18 selected tumor-antigen peptides. All 348 original worksheet slots independently verify, including nine blanks; an absent low-dose row is not imputed. Exact acquisition joins and isotope-source conflicts prevent full training admission. [Hitlist849](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/issues/849) specifies shared ingestion and missing transition exports. No new fit or biological holdout was run. All 109 required new artifacts match committed Git bytes; three failed source-analysis attempts and their recoveries are preserved.

The [transition-export lineage audit](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/155f719b85130367bff37f7d514c60dcb3a66502/experiments/2026-10-25_1857_codex_nontryptic-transition-lineage/README.md) now verifies both original workbooks, all42,941stored cells,54reported form correspondences and684group sums. Published S3A signal reconstruction remains partial (144/213 within relative1e-6). S3B product-only sums match105/117 numeric ordinal candidates, versus1/117 when precursor signal is included. At100fmol the exported labels1/3 do not align with the paper's occupied C/D columns, so acquisition identities remain unresolved. Shared source schemas are qualified with explicit ambiguities; typed ingestion and a consumer recipe are next. No model fit or biological quality improvement is claimed. All63new required artifacts match committed Git bytes. Parent717ed59 CI passed; new155f719 CI is pending.

Independent MS calibration is still limited. The nine-standard dose panel supports protocol-scoped dose response. The broader audit verifies 500 standard stocks and supporting metadata, but separate isotope-area/known-load pairs remain unqualified. PASS05890's listed Skyline file lacks a verified public download route; [Hitlist762](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/issues/762#issuecomment-6399609459) tracks that dependency. A fixed MS-response factor cancels from within-peptide ratios and cannot by itself repair the failed response models.

Still required: independently confirmed biological transfer; precursor-relative APC quantities including undetected/sub-ligand products; machinery/transport/clearance constraints; calibrated observation; qualified auxiliary/TCR cohorts; full affinity/censoring qualification; integration and serving/promotion checks. These remain the completion criteria; source audits and numerical correctness do not substitute for them.


### Nontryptic calibration: qualified source, failed sequence-response predictor

Shared Hitlist source ingestion and independent replay pass; [PR850](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/pull/850), head ac3e048, now passes exact-head Tests40262015632 (including integration) and Docs. The [source report](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/964ffd3ade535208c9ff94b7d31eaa3d89ea7928/experiments/2026-10-26_0236_codex_nontryptic-source-package/README.md) preserves all quantities and isotope/acquisition/length conflicts.

The subsequent [frozen precursor-grouped response comparison](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/19a45c82aa0e42e974cd2690f0bd199f5d32abb0/experiments/2026-10-26_0308_codex_nontryptic-sequence-response/README.md) admits 213 free-spike measurements across 18 peptides / 13 genes using the shared recipe. Sequence ridge fails the primary gate: equal-peptide RMSE 0.682183 versus 0.677664 for a shared dose slope (unit-dose baseline 0.746749). At fixed 1 fmol, predictions are nearly constant: SD 0.043784 versus observed 0.478409. Overall correlation mainly reflects dose. All 663 fits / 10,863 predictions independently replay; exact code, coefficients, prediction archives and plots are published. No independent biological test or APC concentration gain is claimed. Stop tuning this panel; the remaining dependency is diverse independent amount/response anchors and source-matched observation evidence. Full precursor-relative APC availability and matched differentiable/discrete validation remain open.

The subsequent [bounded source screen](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/ae44479388660d80c17abd9da96f2fd2d1422887/experiments/2026-10-26_0344_codex_diverse-quantity-anchors/README.md) qualifies neither of two larger libraries as a broad independently quantified nontryptic response panel. Exact requests, source claims, uncertainty and exclusion decisions are preserved; no new model was fitted. The next source audit follows the APC-derived endolysosomal time-course lead in [Hitlist812](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/issues/812), with run scale and response cancellation qualified before any processing fit. Current head ae44479 CI is pending; the preceding19a45c8 PR CI passed.
